summary: RTB Digital, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting a September 4, 2026 private placement to 12 investors, including founder- and principal-stockholder-affiliated parties, of 456,306 common shares at $11.13 per share for gross proceeds of $5,078,720, sold under Regulation 506(b) as restricted stock without any broker-dealer. A registration rights agreement grants piggyback and one-time demand registration exercisable 180 days after issuance, subject to a 50% registration threshold, terminating on sale, 16 months of effectiveness, or unrestricted Rule 144 resale. The company also confirmed progress toward a previously disclosed Strategic Partnership, applying a $10 million deposit to consideration pending final diligence. Watch negotiation completion and registration timing, not deal terms.
